verdicts.reason: A rearranges the layout for the tall format. The bottle is large, the headline is big and wraps cleanly, the body copy wraps to two readable lines and the CTA is full size. Its flaws: the yellow circle has moved to the top-left, where it crowds the SOLSTICE wordmark, the top is cramped while there is empty space under the CTA, and "fizz" sits alone on its own line. B is just a shrunk copy of the square. The bottle is small, the body copy is tiny at about 11px and runs across almost the full width, the CTA button and the wordmark are undersized, and large empty gaps separate the bottle, headline, copy and CTA, so the layout looks spread thin and has no clear focus.
